related.title: Megatron 張量平行：分片收益與通訊成本
related.titleEn: Megatron tensor parallelism: shards and communication
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：快取形狀與checkpoint一致，頭分組驗證通過，節省容量未誤稱等比例算力節省。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Cache/checkpoint shapes match, grouping passes, and memory savings are not proportional-compute claims.
related.difference: 在減少單卡計算的同時加上必要collective，判斷平行度提高是否仍有收益。
related.differenceEn: Add required collectives to reduced per-device compute and evaluate increasing parallelism.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: KV容量與Hkv成正比，query頭數不直接決定KV儲存；權重及注意力映射必須相容。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 L32、query頭32、D128、T4096、FP16=2 bytes；先用Hkv32。 快取容量KV=2×32×32×128×4096×2/2^30=2 GiB。
簡化層時間T=C/p+K，p為平行度、K為量測或假設的collective時間，不能忽略K。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 單卡C=16 ms；p4時collective2 ms；p8時collective3 ms，無重疊。 p4時間16/4+2=6 ms，速度比16/6=2.6667，非4倍。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: KV storage scales with Hkv, not directly with query heads; weights and attention mapping must remain compatible. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. L32, 32 query heads, D128, T4096, FP16 two bytes; baselineHkv32. KV=2×32×32×128×4096×2/2^30=2 GiB.

Simplified layer time T=C/p+K, where p is parallelism and K collective time. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Single-deviceC16 ms; collective2 ms atp4 and 3 ms atp8, without overlap. Atp4, time=6 ms, speedup2.6667 rather than4.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LiteRT INT8：零點、尺度與量化誤差
related.titleEn: LiteRT INT8: zero points, scales and quantization error
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：快取形狀與checkpoint一致，頭分組驗證通過，節省容量未誤稱等比例算力節省。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Cache/checkpoint shapes match, grouping passes, and memory savings are not proportional-compute claims.
related.difference: 正確處理零點與範圍，量化前後誤差按同一實值尺度比較。
related.differenceEn: Handle zero point and range correctly, and compare quantization errors in real-value units.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: KV容量與Hkv成正比，query頭數不直接決定KV儲存；權重及注意力映射必須相容。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 L32、query頭32、D128、T4096、FP16=2 bytes；先用Hkv32。 快取容量KV=2×32×32×128×4096×2/2^30=2 GiB。
x≈(q−z)s，q=round(x/s)+z再限制到整數範圍；無飽和時最近捨入誤差≤s/2。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 s=0.02、z=−3，x=0.31；最近捨入遇中點採ties-to-even，量化範圍−128..127。 x/s=15.5→16，q=13，還原(13+3)×0.02=0.32，誤差0.01。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: KV storage scales with Hkv, not directly with query heads; weights and attention mapping must remain compatible. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. L32, 32 query heads, D128, T4096, FP16 two bytes; baselineHkv32. KV=2×32×32×128×4096×2/2^30=2 GiB.

x≈(q−z)s, with q=round(x/s)+z clipped to integer range; without saturation, error≤s/2. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. s0.02, z−3, x0.31, nearest ties-to-even rounding and range−128..127. 15.5 rounds16, q13, reconstruction0.32, error0.01.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
